# .github/workflows

GitHub Actions workflows for the repo.

## Contents

| Path                                         | What it is                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| -------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| [`ci.yml`](ci.yml)                           | CI on every push to `main`, and on pull requests except those changing only `README.md` and `AGENTS.md` files: one job runs format check, lint and typecheck; four shards each build and run a quarter of the tests on their own Postgres; `test` reports them as one. A new push to a pull request cancels its older run. The first job also checks that `sanoma/internal/bridge`'s generated client and the generated migrations (`sanoma/workflows`'s, `sanoma/better-auth`'s) are up to date, and on a pull request that its new migrations are newer than `main`'s |
| [`docs.yml`](docs.yml)                       | The format check on pull requests that change a `README.md` or `AGENTS.md` file, since `ci.yml` skips those that change nothing else                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| [`visual.yml`](visual.yml)                   | Pull requests that touch what the app shows: one comment with each changed README still's before, after and diff; see [readme-shots](../../scripts/readme-shots/README.md#on-a-pull-request)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| [`desktop.yml`](desktop.yml)                 | The desktop shell's smoke test on changes to `packages/desktop` or the launcher: Electron under xvfb opens a fixture company with a fake launcher (Playwright); on Windows its unit tests, and the real packaged app: the smoke test, New Company from a local registry of this commit's packages, and the Squirrel installer                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| [`release.yml`](release.yml)                 | Run by hand on `main`: publishes each public package whose version is not yet on npm, then pushes the runtime image `ghcr.io/sanoma-ai/runtime:<sanoma version>` when ghcr.io lacks it; see [Release](../../README.md#release)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| [`desktop-release.yml`](desktop-release.yml) | Run by hand on `main`: builds the macOS app (arm64 and x64, dmg and zip), signed and notarized, and the Windows x64 installer, signed with Azure Artifact Signing, and when both pass uploads one draft release `v<version>`, the apps' update once published; see [Desktop (preview)](../../README.md#desktop-preview)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
